name: cocina
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: attached cocina photograph. Asset type: exact-geometry grout segmentation and renovation working plate for a browser color simulator. Keep the photograph pixel-aligned: identical camera, crop, dimensions, furniture, plants, water, tile faces, tile edges, tile color and lighting. Change ONLY the grout between ceramic tiles: remove stains and damaged grout and fill every grout joint uniformly with highly saturated pure MAGENTA #FF00FF colored matte grout. Magenta is a technical selection color, not a final product. Paint ALL tile grout in floor and tiled walls (or all six sample boards), but NEVER tile faces, wood cabinet joints, bricks/mortar, furniture, coping, drain hardware, glass or plants. Keep seam thickness physically realistic and consistent. Grout magenta must be saturated enough for reliable chroma selection; no magenta glow or spill onto tiles. Preserve illumination in grout, but use near-pure magenta with low green channel. Absolutely do not redraw architecture or change tile grid. No text or overlays. Output a full photograph, NOT a black/white mask.
